name: How long does the plumbing sub-trade phase take during an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does the plumbing sub-trade phase take during an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough-in plumbing coordination typically takes one to three days on site, depending on project complexity. Straightforward bathroom updates where drain lines remain stationary are often roughed in within a single day. Full-scale kitchen renovations, basement additions, or complex bathroom remodels involving relocated drains and custom shower valves can require several days. Because HH Remodeling LLC directly manages project scheduling in the Denver area, we sequence rough-in work to transition immediately into drywalling and tile prep without leaving long idle gaps in your home remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough-in plumbing typically takes 1 to 3 days, followed by final fixture installation once tile, cabinetry, and interior painting are complete.
